g.text: Tag Setup Deep Dive — What Goes Where on the Site
Practical layout of base tags, event tags, and server-side layers
SITELINE 2 CONVERTING PAGES ONLY (fire on user action)
SITELINE 3 SERVER-SIDE LAYER (optional but increasingly standard)
Rule of thumb: every page gets the base tag, converting pages get the event tag, server-side layer adds resilience and cross-device match.
